hyperedges.label: Finance / Bookkeeping Center Repositioning MVP Sequence

nodes.label: A Deterministic Invariant Validates an AI Extraction
nodes.norm_label: a deterministic invariant validates an ai extraction
nodes.rationale: Build the arithmetic invariant once and it protects against a wrong answer from a hand-coded parser and an AI extraction equally, instead of needing separate trust logic for each.

nodes.label: Firestore Rules Cannot Filter a List Query
nodes.norm_label: firestore rules cannot filter a list query
nodes.rationale: A get()-based cross-document check works for a single read but not a list query, so the visibility flag must be denormalized and matched by the query's own where clause.

nodes.label: PDF Text Baseline Redaction Geometry
nodes.rationale: A line's y from pdf.js is the text baseline, not the visual top, so a symmetric small pad leaves text visibly uncovered; rasterize before redacting because drawing over live text leaves it selectable underneath.

nodes.label: Sequential Multi-Document Writes Need a Batch
nodes.norm_label: sequential multi-document writes need a batch
nodes.rationale: A partial failure could leave a transaction and its matched record disagreeing; a stuck link that is visibly still linked is easier to notice than silent undetectable drift.

nodes.label: Matching Engine (rule-based scoring)
nodes.rationale: Rules-based rather than LLM-based so matching stays transparent and explainable; high-confidence suggestions are pre-positioned but never auto-confirmed.

nodes.label: Settlement Linking / Double-Count Guard
nodes.rationale: Prevents the classic double-count where the card purchase and the bank debit that pays the card are both matched to the same expense.

nodes.label: Payment-Proof Automation
nodes.rationale: Automatically crops and highlights the matched payment line so repetitive accountant/auditor preparation work is removed; a crop too tight is avoided because auditors need surrounding context for credibility.

nodes.label: Document / Settlement / Ledger Amount Layers
nodes.rationale: Keeps receipt evidence and payment evidence separate but linked, and treats the actual payment source as the settlement source of truth.

nodes.label: Account Codes
nodes.rationale: Account coding needs human confirmation for salary/tax/related-party/capital items, so unlike merchant rules there is no Auto-Approve toggle at all; codes are added alongside Category, never replacing it.

nodes.label: Company Package Export
nodes.rationale: A personal account's statement is never bundled as-is because it mixes personal and company charges in one file; the raw source is redacted or excluded rather than relying on filtering the derived data.

nodes.label: Extraction Validation
nodes.rationale: Never block saving — the advisory banner matches the statement panel's own non-blocking 'check carefully before importing' behavior.

nodes.label: FinanceRecord Model
nodes.rationale: Expense and Income are unified at the code layer but stored in two physical collections so existing rules, Storage paths, and matched-transaction references stay valid without a risky physical merge.

nodes.label: Income
nodes.rationale: Income is a same-level FinanceRecord to Expense in its own collection, never a negative expense category.

nodes.label: Invoices & Purchase Orders
nodes.rationale: Many issuers with arbitrary layouts rule out a positional parser, so the OCR+Gemini pipeline with mandatory human review is used instead; header-level only, no line items.

nodes.label: Month-End Report
nodes.rationale: 'Needs Review' and 'sync-failed' spec statuses are not modeled because neither maps cleanly onto a field shared by all four FinanceRecord collections.

nodes.label: Operation Center Sync
nodes.rationale: A client-writable Firestore boolean is a UI convenience, never a security boundary — the real gate is a server-side connector registry keyed by projectId.

nodes.label: PDF Statement Parsing
nodes.rationale: Column boundaries are calibrated from the data's x-clustering, never from header label positions, and no tier is trusted without the deterministic totals check.

nodes.label: Personal-to-Company Classification
nodes.rationale: Deliberately conservative — the app never auto-decides a final claim, tax category, or allocation, only defaults the classification field so review can happen efficiently.

nodes.label: Project Sharing
nodes.rationale: Personal-account transactions stay invisible to collaborators until classified non-personal; this must be a query-filterable field because Firestore rules cannot filter a list query.

nodes.label: Reconciliation
nodes.rationale: Rules-based and transparent; PO- and income-linking are manual-only so exclusivity falls out of existing status logic rather than needing a tiebreak between two automatic scorers.

nodes.label: CLAUDE.md
nodes.rationale: Guidelines bias toward caution over speed because common LLM coding mistakes are costly; for trivial tasks, use judgment.

nodes.label: Expense Operations Center — Development Playbook
nodes.rationale: Actionable distillation of the longer docs — read before touching the code.

nodes.label: Lessons Learned
nodes.rationale: Non-obvious bugs, dead ends, and decisions are kept here so the reasoning isn't lost to git history.

nodes.label: Payment Reconciliation — Merged Spec v1
nodes.rationale: Keeps the audit-pack brief's generic multi-rail data model and folds in the credit card doc's row-classification detail, narrowed to what Phase 1 actually needs.

nodes.label: HKD/RMB Settlement and Filing Evidence Automation Brief
nodes.norm_label: hkd/rmb settlement and filing evidence automation brief
nodes.rationale: Framed as payment reconciliation and filing evidence, not only statement matching, because for China-paid expenses the true settlement evidence may be a RMB bank or wallet record.

nodes.label: Duplicates Must Surface, Never Silently Skip
nodes.norm_label: duplicates must surface, never silently skip
nodes.rationale: For a bookkeeping tool, both silent data loss and silently withholding a real transaction from the ledger (even temporarily) are unacceptable.

nodes.label: Bank Transactions View
nodes.rationale: Deliberately read-only so match/confirm/ignore/link actions are not re-implemented a second time; rows link out to Reconciliation.

nodes.label: Amount+Currency Alone Is Not Enough Evidence
nodes.norm_label: amount+currency alone is not enough evidence
nodes.rationale: Date proximity is not optional context — disqualify pairings absurd on an orthogonal axis rather than merely under-scoring them, because a strong generic signal can paper over the absence of every specific one.
